scope.semantics: algebra-element semantics; no syntactic definability claim
scope.warning: Census evidence is not a proof of a general implication.

definitions.C: box(x) tensor box(y) <= box(x tensor y)
definitions.CtrBox: box(x) <= box(x) tensor box(x); not global contraction
definitions.Con_L_sem: box(bottom) <= bottom; semantic reading of not box bottom
definitions.Con_EG_elem: there exists an algebra element x with box(x) <= bottom
definitions.disjunction: box(x join y) = box(x) join box(y)
definitions.SC_elem: for every algebra element x there is p with p = box(p) -> x
definitions.negBoxFP_elem: there is an algebra element p with p = neg(box(p))
